source: Zabihi et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:11283, Fig. 3 (event-level FROC of the CatBoost ensemble, TUSZ v2.0.3)
method: Digitized from the published figure image: marker pixels detected by colour (blue, b - r > 60), thin connecting line removed by a binary opening with a radius-2 disk, connected components -> centroids; pixel -> data by a linear fit to the grid lines (x: 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 2.5, 3 FA/h; y: 0.2-1.0). 34 blobs; a few neighbouring markers merge into one blob, so some markers are averaged. The starred operating point is replaced by its published value (0.682, 0.749). Accuracy about +-0.02 in each axis; use as a visual reference only, never as numbers to compare against.
